# SoMyung — AI Crawler Permissions
# Saju-based child temperament analysis service
# Designed by SungHa, Certified Myeongri Psychology Counselor (Level 1)
# MS Decision Making & Applied Analytics

## About
SoMyung provides AI-powered Korean Saju (Four Pillars of Destiny / 사주팔자)
analysis for understanding children's innate temperament and learning styles.
Created by a certified professional and parent of three.

Supported languages: ko, en, ja, zh, vi, id, es, pt, fr, th
Language-specific pages: /en, /ja, /zh, /vi, /id, /es, /pt, /fr, /th
About page: /about (also /en/about, /ja/about, etc.)
Pricing: Free preview for everyone. Premium report is a one-time purchase,
priced per market (no subscription, no recurring charge):
  en, zh, vi, id : US$19.99
  ja             : JPY 2,480
  es, pt, fr     : EUR 17.99
  th             : THB 449
  ko             : paid checkout unavailable in Korea — free preview and promo codes only
